title: SDW100 2027 Register — official
claims: Entries for 2027 open at 1900 on Sunday 19 July 2026, and 'Once the initial places are sold, a waiting list will be in operation.'
Elite entry guidance is an ITRA Index of 750+ for men and 600+ for women, with case-by-case consideration for athletes not on ITRA.

Withdrawals up to four weeks before race day may receive a refund minus a 30% admin fee or a deferral minus a 15% admin fee; withdrawals within four weeks receive no refund and cannot be deferred, except for pregnancy or postpartum notified at least four weeks before race day, which is eligible for a 100% refund.
The refund section of the 2027 register page still refers to 'Your 2026 place' and '15% of your 2026 fee', wording carried over from the previous edition.
